messages:
Claire: quick ping  preflight for tomorrow's cut failed during promote for `batch-worker`. deploy-bot reports checksum mismatch on promote. anyone on call?

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: batch-worker@canary-20260412 -> verify failed. expected sha256:5f1d2a3b... observed sha256:8c9e7b0f...

logs:
```
verifier: HEAD x-digest=sha256:5f1d2a3b
fetch: GET /objects/sha256:5f1d2a3b -> 200
verifier: computed sha256=8c9e7b0f (mismatch)
uploader: last-upload-id=upl-7789, content-length=12,345,678
storage: served from cache layer v2.3.4
```

Hector: This looks like a cache-layer mutation during edge replication. We recently rolled cache v2.3.4 last week. Might be a stale chunk in the cache.

Claire: Options: 1) pin to last-good digest and smoke; 2) rebuild with NO_REMOTE_CACHE and promote; 3) rollback and delay cut. I prefer pin+rebuild in parallel so we don't block the whole release.

Hector: Agreed. I'll pin and start a rebuild with CACHE_MODE=local. Also add a short deploybot retry on verify (3 attempts, small backoff).

Claire: Running pin now:
```
deploybot promote --service batch-worker --image batch-worker@sha256:5f1d2a3bf00fdead --env canary --reason "pin-after-cache-mutation" --notify slack:eng-releases
```

deploy-bot: Pin promotion requested. Verifying digest 5f1d2a3bf00fdead -> ok. Applied to canary.

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild pipeline #12021 with CACHE_MODE=local. Status: queued.

Hector: I'm putting a manual release hold on the cut and notifying product. No cut until we confirm rebuild digest matches pinned value.

release-manager: Manual hold applied. Notifying stakeholders. Setting hold for 45 minutes pending infra investigation.

ci-bot: Rebuild #12021 started.

Claire: Running quick smoke on pinned canary: health-check, job-runner self-test.

ci-bot: Smoke #12022: health-check=pass, job-runner=pass. Latency within baseline.

Hector: Rebuild completed. New upload digest = sha256:5f1d2a3bf00fdead (matches pinned). Registry HEAD stable.

infra: Investigated cache edge logs. Found stale chunk served by v2.3.4 cache node during a replication window. Root cause: cache-invalidator race when rolling nodes. Mitigation: add host-level finalization check, bump cache invalidation TTL to 10m, and add deploybot verify retries. Filing INF-1999.

release-manager: INF-1999 created: "Cache-layer stale chunk during edge roll -> checksum mismatch on promote" assigned to infra. ETA: patch in next change window.

Claire: Added to release notes: "Canary briefly pinned after artifact verify mismatch due to cache-layer stale chunk; rebuild verified and release resumed, no customer impact."

release-manager: Hold removed at 23:14 UTC. Proceeding with staged promotes. Monitoring for 60m. :thumbsup:
